description_short: Exports read-only factory counts, machine inventory, production identities and configurations, reserves, operating history, and train traffic health to the local CoI calculator.
description_long: Writes a local JSON snapshot containing vehicle totals, selected completed/running entity counts, Groundwater Pump identity, pause state, locations, vehicle-zone membership, aquifer reserve and capacity, and depleted-output settings, completed production, worker, and settlement entities inside named vehicle areas for module binding, recipe-aware production identities, zone-aware Data Centers, Water Chillers, greenhouse configurations, rocket infrastructure, solar panels, and stationary tracked infrastructure, eligible standalone Gold and Fuel Gas reserves, current repeatable research and edicts, completed-cycle operating averages, and sustained train track waits. It does not modify gameplay state or expose a network service.
